name: Aritzia
band_note: core-garment rule, 13 Oct: the $28 ribbed baby tee and $58 smocked top are not its core tee and shirt
why: Women's clothing under its own labels (Babaton, Tna and others): puffers around $275, trousers, knits and dresses, sold through its own boutiques and website.
origin: Founded in Vancouver, Canada in 1984 by Brian Hill.

quote.q: The idea was simple: offer beautiful clothes in aspirational spaces with exceptional service.

opview: “The idea was simple: offer beautiful clothes in aspirational spaces with exceptional service.” — Aritzia (house), Our History, aritzia.com

facts_read.source: brand site; Aritzia investor site (TSE: ATZ quote; Annual Report 2026 PDF); GOTS database; Vinted catalog page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

price_read.sublines: Aritzia house labels sold under Aritzia (Babaton, Wilfred, TNA, Sunday Best, Denim Forum, Super World, HomeStretch, Little Moon). EXCLUDED: stocked brands now sold on aritzia.com (AGOLDE, Citizens of Humanity).

doors.note: site aritzia.com/us; locator lists 154 boutiques (83 US, 71 Canada); outlet = locator text calls it an outlet boutique (2); 3 more sit in outlet centers (Fashion Outlets of Chicago, Las Vegas North Premium Outlets, Sawgrass Mills); the locator does not call them outlets, but they are counted as outlets by location (ruled 10 Oct: a store in an outlet center is an outlet); 2 rows are temporary locations during renovation; locator data errors kept and flagged (Perimeter Mall state AL, Kierland ZIP six digits, Keystone city blank); no Wilfred or other sub-banner doors in the US
